newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BATISTUTA TO STAY AT FIORENTINA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BATISTUTA TO STAY AT FIORENTINA.

text.p: Gabriel Batistuta said on Monday he was happy at Italy's Fiorentina and would probably stay there for at least another two years.

The Argentine striker recently failed to return from Buenos Aires for a pre-season team meeting, prompting speculation he might leave the Florence-based side. His agent had said he was irritable and suffering from tension.
But Batistuta, reunited with his team mates at a training camp south of the Italian city, said he had never considered leaving a club where he is idolised by many supporters.
"I've never rejected Florence or Fiorentina and I never considered not returning (from Argentina)," he told reporters. "The fans would miss me.
"There were a few problems with a couple of people at the club but now I'm fine.
"I think I'll stay in Florence until the year 2000."
Batistuta, who has played at Fiorentina for the past six seasons, was linked to both Barcelona and Real Madrid at the end of last month.
